pages.text: This pack is built for co-op, and getting a friend in takes seconds. No server to rent, nothing to set up.
$(li)Press $(l)Esc$(), click $(l)Open to LAN$(), then $(l)Start LAN World$().$(li)An address appears in chat. Share the $(l)IP$() with your friends, not the $(l)port$().
Your friends open $(l)Multiplayer$() from the menu, add that address, and join.$(br)$(br)$(o)Everyone must be on the same version of the pack.$()
